Name: Zelzah
ModernLocation: Unknown; candidates include the Zela area, Beit Jala, and Kiriath-jearim
Description: Zelzah was a place on the border of Benjamin, at Rachel's tomb, where Samuel told Saul he would find two men who would tell him the donkeys were found.
BiblicalSignificance: Zelzah is one of Samuel's signs to Saul: the second sign on the road to his anointing, at Rachel's sepulchre.
